verdict.rationale: Abacum documents headcount planning, approval and forecasting inside the same connected model as the budget, so planned hires carry into the financial forecast (abacum-docs-17). It also claims per-new-hire planning via HRIS connection (abacum-docs-11, abacum-docs-3) and scenario changes in which hiring moves together with revenue and cash (abacum-docs-16). Missing for 10: explicit role-level planning detail, explicit tie-in to payroll actuals (only HRIS is mentioned), in-depth docs on how hire costs map to expense lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
